G1.noise_floor_match_definition: median |d| over all samples of the matched stretches (bounded by 2.0 sv by the selection)
G1.noise_floor_nf6_definition: median |d| over all samples of the near runs: runs of consecutive samples on one segment with |d| <= 6.0 sv, >= 2.5 mm
G1.rule: >= 30 fibers with a matched stretch (|d| <= 2.0 sv on one segment over >= 40.0 sv (0.384 mm) of consecutive 1 sv samples) AND NF_match <= 2.0 sv AND NF6 <= 2.0 sv

skips.reason: no strip row inside a matched stretch

all.fiber_floor_note: the human fiber itself, one point per scored row: the ground truth noise floor

G2.rule: transfers = pooled mean |d| <= 1.5 sv AND >= 70% of nodes within 2 sv AND both baselines beaten (paired fiber-bootstrap 95% CI of baseline - strip mean |d| above 0); otherwise degrades
